create.name: Aluminea
create.bio:
Aluminea is a Usui and Tibetan Reiki Master Teacher on California's Central Coast. She opened her private practice, Blossoming Lotus Reiki, in 2011 and works from a studio in Templeton, travelling to Los Angeles and Orange County each month and seeing people in Hawaii as well. She is also a yoga teacher, makes custom malas through a two-week intention ceremony, and co-founded Heart Space Sanctuary, a non-denominational spiritual community where she serves as head minister.

A session with her begins with a conversation about what the client wants to release and invite, moves into a guided meditation shaped around that intention and then Reiki, given with light touch or with the hands just above the body, and ends with any impressions she received and simple practices to take home. Sessions can also be held over video. She teaches all three levels of Usui Reiki in person and online, from the first attunement to the master symbol, using her own manual, The Reiki Experience, and she leads occasional yin yoga, chakra and sound bath evenings on the Central Coast. A free set of short guided meditations on her site covers grounding, higher-self connection, self-love and morning practice, and more of her recordings are on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Energetic Alignment Sessions
courses.description: A 90-minute one-to-one session that starts with naming what you want to let go of and call in, followed by a tailored guided meditation, Reiki and a debrief with practices to continue at home. Offered in person in Templeton and Southern California or by video, with a week of email support afterwards.

courses.title: Usui Reiki Certifications (Levels 1 to 3)
courses.description: Her Reiki training path, from Shoden (first attunement and self-treatment) through Okuden (the three symbols and distance work) to Shinpiden (the master symbol and Reiki grids). Classes run in person or online, with her own manual.
courses.price: Level 1 from $111 USD online; in person $77 USD deposit plus sliding scale $111–$333 USD

courses.title: Okuden: Usui Reiki Level 2 (online course)
courses.description: The self-paced online version of second-level Usui Reiki, covering the three Level 2 symbols, how to invoke them, the full set of hand positions and sending Reiki at a distance. Suited to those who want to start practising for others.

courses.title: Custom Malas
courses.description: A two-week ceremony in which she designs and makes a mala around your intentions, beginning with an opening alignment session on Zoom or in Paso Robles and ending with a blessing. You receive notes on the stones and materials chosen.

free_resources.title: Aluminea on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Short guided meditations for mornings, connecting with the higher self, welcoming love and abundance, free to hear in the app or online.

free_resources.title: Meditate & Transform: guided meditations
free_resources.description: A free set of twelve guided meditations on her website, each ten minutes or less, starting with a foundational breath and moving through grounding, releasing old patterns, self-love and connecting with the higher self.
